query: NVIDIA GeForce RTX sales Q2 fiscal 2027
normalized: 2027 fiscal geforce nvidia q2 rtx sales

output.content:
NVIDIA did **not separately disclose GeForce RTX sales** in Q2 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended July 26, 2026), because it replaced the standalone Gaming category with the broader **Edge Computing** platform. [[1]] 

The closest reported figure is **Edge Computing revenue of $7.2 billion**, up **13% sequentially** and **27% year over year**; this category includes GeForce/RTX-related business but is not a pure GeForce RTX sales measure. [[2]] 

For context, NVIDIA’s total Q2 FY2027 revenue was **$96.221 billion**, while Data Center revenue was **$89.0 billion**. [[3]] [[2]]
